```python
class ResultReader(NodeVisitor):
    """Strict inverse of MainBuilder: recovers values from named leaf objects."""
    def __init__(self, assignment):
        self.number = 0
        self.assignment = assignment
    def _next(self): ...
    def _lookup(self):
        name = self._next()
        if name not in self.assignment: raise Exception('missing object ' + name)
        return self.assignment[name]
```
